entities.summary: Meldal Church is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Orkland Municipality in Trøndelag county, Norway. It is located in the village of Meldal. It is the church for the Meldal parish which is part of the Orkdal prosti (deanery) in the Diocese of Nidaros. The red, concrete and wood church was built in a long church style in 1988 by the architect John Mosand. The church seats about 375 people.
